statesWithNoListedHQ.justification: No NSE/BSE-listed company maintains a registered office in the state; the economy is dominated by hydropower projects owned by central/state PSUs registered elsewhere.
No listed company has a registered office in the state; largest employers are state undertakings and central PSU units.
No NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; economy is agriculture and government services.
No NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; ONGC Tripura Power Company is unlisted.
StockMagnets records zero NSE/BSE-listed registered offices; pharma plants in Sikkim (Sun, Cipla, Alkem, Zydus, IPCA) belong to companies registered in Maharashtra/Gujarat.
No NSE/BSE-listed company registered in the UT; industrial units at Puducherry belong to Tamil Nadu- and Maharashtra-registered parents.
No listed registered offices; economy is tourism, fisheries and defence.
Now merged with Dadra & Nagar Haveli into a single UT; listed registered offices in the merged UT cluster at Silvassa and are recorded under stateCode 'dn'.
